function.name: calculate_time
function.description: Calculates the time taken to cover a distance at a certain speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

distance.description: The distance to be covered in meters. This is a float type value.

speed.description: The speed at which the object is moving in m/s. This is a float type value.

I don’t have direct access to a live clock, so I can’t tell you the exact current time from here.  
The easiest way to get it would be:

* On most devices just look at the status bar (phone, laptop, etc.).
* If you’re on a computer, open a terminal and run `date` (Linux/macOS) or `time /t` (Windows).
* In a web browser, you can also check your system’s clock or search “current time” online.

If you let me know what timezone you’re interested in, I can explain how to convert between zones once you’ve got the base time!
